Maya (ML Eng): heads-up — q4b bring-up for v3-model shows a weird longtail drop vs q8 baseline on the summarization holdout. not full regression but concentrated in deid + code snippets. cc @Raj @Sophie
Raj (Annot Ops): any concrete numbers yet?
Maya (ML Eng): yes — on our 20k promptset: quant q4b accuracy proxy down ~6% on the deid cohort, hallucination rate up on 1.2k longtail examples. quick sample: `SELECT count(*) FROM samplebank WHERE cohort='deid_longtail' AND flagged=true;` returned 1243
Sophie (Curation): hmm. were those in the golden set or in general samplebank?
Maya (ML Eng): mix — ~180 are in golden; the rest are candidate anchors. suspect dedupe/normalization mismatch after tokenizer tweak + quant kernel.
Alex (Quant): sounds like kv-cache alignment + int4 rounding might surface different tokenization splits for code blocks. can we get a small repro set?
Maya (ML Eng): pushing a 500-example repro slice to the shared bucket now: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/1784543210/repro_500.jsonl
Raj (Annot Ops): I'll schedule a relabel pass for the 180 golden items first. priority: verify ground-truth, check <masking/deid> correctness, mark if it's a model-induced hallucination vs prompt error. ETA 24h.
Sophie (Curation): need a quick dedupe run on the 500 sample before relabeling — last dedupe pipeline was updated with fuzzyhash v2 which changed equivalence. if duplicates are spikey, labelers will waste cycles.
Maya (ML Eng): agreed. @Nina can you spin up a short job to run the dedupe script on that bucket? command we use: ```python tools/dedupe/run.py --input repro_500.jsonl --out repro_500.dedup.jsonl --threshold 0.86```
Nina (SRE): can do. will run in a 30m job and post logs. ETA 15m.
LabelerBot: started a relabel job: job_id=lbl-7721, targets=180 (golden), note="focus: deid masking + hallucination flag"
Alex (Quant): while dedupe/relabel runs — two proposals: 1) run q8 fallback for the top-20 most frequent prompts in repro to confirm kernel vs data; 2) produce tokenization diff for the repro items: `tools/tokenize/diff.sh repro_500` (shows split differences)
Sophie (Curation): good. I'll also extract the top mismatch templates and make an 'anchor' shortlist for a micro-golden update if relabels change consensus. want to avoid replacing golden wholesale.
Raj (Annot Ops): labeler team prefers batches of 25 with attached context + previous model outputs. can we include both q8 and q4b outputs in the batch? that speeds triage.
Maya (ML Eng): yes will attach `outputs/q8_vs_q4b.zip` to each batch. also include a short rubric: 1) is response safe/contains PII leakage? 2) hallucination scale (0-3) 3) fidelity to prompt (0-2)
Nina (SRE): dedupe job finished — 500 -> 462 after fuzzyhash v2. logs: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/1784543210/dedupe.log
LabelerBot: relabel job lbl-7721 progress: 25/180 done — note: annotators reporting many near-duplicates despite dedupe; suggest threshold tweak
Alex (Quant): can we snapshot token-level logits for the 50 most divergent cases? that helps see whether quant noise concentrates on rare tokens (braces, long identifiers).
Maya (ML Eng): yes, I'll run a logits capture with `--topk 50 --save-path repro_logits/` and share link.
Sophie (Curation): if relabels change any golden labels, I propose a micro-golden update: take only items with unanimous relabels and add a small provenance tag `golden_v2_qbringup_1784543210` rather than replacing v1. keeps rollback easy.
Raj (Annot Ops): agreed. labelers also requested a brief session tomorrow to calibrate the hallucination rubric — want to avoid labeler drift.
Maya (ML Eng): booked 30m calibration: tomorrow 10:30 PT. invite sent to @Raj @Sophie @Alex + label leads.
LabelerBot: relabel job lbl-7721 completed — 180/180. summary: 26 items updated consensus -> 18 marked as model hallucination -> 8 label corrections to ground truth. full CSV: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/1784543210/relabel_summary.csv
Alex (Quant): interesting — can we try a targeted quant profile: int4+perchannel scaling on the top-8 attention layers for the micro-golden items and run the micro-bench? if that reduces hallucination on those 26, it's a good signal.
Maya (ML Eng): starting targeted quant run now. will push results to the same bucket and open a PR with perf/quality diffs.
Sophie (Curation): after PR lands, I'll prepare a micro-golden patch: add the 18 hallucination-confirmed items as negative checks (expect hallucination=false) and the 8 corrected GT items as replacements. annotate provenance fields: `curation:relabellog=lbl-7721`, `curation:ticket=INC-1327`
Nina (SRE): opened INC-1327 for tracking infra + job artifacts.
Maya (ML Eng): thanks all. next steps: - Alex will post targeted quant run results (by EOD) - Sophie will stage micro-golden patch (after PR) - Raj will run calibration session and then ramp relabel cadence if needed
Alex (Quant): posted results: targeted quant reduced hallucination on the 26 items by 60% vs q4b baseline, latency +1.8% — findings in gs://redwood-test/qbringup/1784543210/quant_profile_report.md
Sophie (Curation): micro-golden patch ready in staging, awaiting PR merge. patch includes dedupe fingerprint and provenance fields.
Raj (Annot Ops): calibration session done — labels consistent, we will roll out a 2-week enhanced monitoring: daily sample of 50 from production deid cohort.
Maya (ML Eng): closing loop: if micro-golden results hold, we can promote the targeted quant profile as a fallback/policy for deid_longtail route. filing an RFC next week. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Nina (SRE): archived job artifacts under the incident ticket.
LabelerBot: thread auto-archived.
